description: This file implements a simple IRC bot library with classes for managing IRC connections, channels, and bot behavior, including reconnection logic, command handling, and mode management.

classes.name: SingleServerIRCBot
classes.description: A class representing a single-server IRC bot with reconnection and channel management capabilities.

classes.name: IRCDict
classes.description: A custom dictionary class for case-insensitive IRC key management.

classes.name: Channel
classes.description: A class for storing and managing information about an IRC channel, including users, modes, and permissions.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the IRC bot by connecting to the server and initiating the event loop.

methods.name: jump_server
methods.description: Switches to the next server in the server list, disconnecting from the current one.

methods.name: get_version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the bot.

methods.name: on_ctcp
methods.description: Handles CTCP requests such as VERSION, PING, and DCC CHAT.

methods.name: on_dccchat
methods.description: Placeholder for handling DCC chat requests.
